name: AGI Infra Ltd
tagline: Punjab affordable/mid-income housing developer with 25% ROE and no promoter pledge, but reported growth has decelerated to flat (Q1 FY27) against a full 34x P/E; a large Rs 5,120 Cr FY26-30 launch pipeline is the whole story and it is a multi-year absorption play
business_overview: AGI Infra is a Jalandhar (Punjab) based real estate developer focused on affordable and mid-income housing, including Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana projects. It is positioned within a post-2018 industry consolidation cycle where balance-sheet-repaired, largely net-cash developers are compounding pre-sales at 20-25%+ while trading cheap relative to their embedded project margins.
fundamentals_narrative: Quality metrics remain strong on paper: ROE ~25%, ROCE ~21%, no promoter pledge (0%), modest leverage (borrowings Rs 167 Cr, D/E ~0.36). FY26 revenue Rs 353 Cr grew only ~8.5% YoY and PAT Rs 95 Cr grew 42% (EPS Rs 7.59); Q1 FY27 (Jun-26) was flat YoY at Rs 96 Cr revenue / Rs 27 Cr PAT. Real-estate percentage-completion accounting means reported P&L lags pre-sales by 3-4 years, so the headline is a lagging indicator - but the reported trajectory is nonetheless decelerating (5-yr rev CAGR 26%, 3-yr 14%, latest quarter ~0%). Operating cash flow is weak versus PAT (FY26 OCF Rs 27 Cr, FY25 OCF negative Rs 20 Cr) and working-capital days have ballooned to ~149 from ~45 as work-in-progress builds; the March-2026 QIP (Rs 75 Cr at Rs 265, five FPIs) plus debt is funding the build. FII holding rose from ~0% to 4.68% (27 investors) over four quarters and Nuvama initiated a Buy - genuine external validation the VP thread still lacks. Deep-dive pass 1 (2026-09-02): figures refreshed from screener.in / Trendlyne / CARE; the ongoing 66.79 lakh sq ft portfolio is ~62% pre-sold (Rs 1,137 Cr booked, only ~Rs 450 Cr collected by Dec-24) and the FY26-30 pipeline is ~9.8 msf at ~Rs 5,120 Cr GDV on ~12.2 msf of land reserves.

bull_case: High-quality regional developer: ROE ~25%, ROCE ~21%, zero promoter pledge, low D/E ~0.36 - a balance-sheet-repaired survivor of the post-2018 Punjab consolidation

Large embedded pipeline: ~9.8 msf / ~Rs 5,120 Cr GDV planned FY26-30 on ~12.2 msf land reserves, plus an ongoing 66.79 lakh sq ft portfolio already ~62% pre-sold (Rs 1,137 Cr booked) with collections still to flow
First genuine institutional validation: FII holding up from ~0% to 4.68% across 27 investors in four quarters via the Rs 75 Cr QIP; Nuvama initiated with a Buy
Percentage-completion accounting means reported revenue lags booked pre-sales by 3-4 years, so recognised revenue understates contracted momentum
bear_case: Reported growth has decelerated hard - FY26 revenue +8.5% YoY, Q1 FY27 flat YoY - against a full 34x trailing P/E that needs 30%+ EPS CAGR to be fair; the multiple is leaning entirely on un-booked pipeline 3-5 years out
Weak cash conversion (FY26 OCF Rs 27 Cr vs PAT Rs 95 Cr; FY25 OCF negative) and working-capital days up to ~149 from ~45; growth is being funded by QIP + debt, not internal accruals

Governance: recurring material related-party transactions with promoter-linked AGI Construction Pvt Ltd (MD Sukhdev Singh Khinda has indirect interest) for construction work on the company's own projects - member approval sought Aug 2025
Single-region (Punjab) concentration; execution/absorption/approval-timeline dependent; zero DII holding and the company's own ValuePickr thread still has one post of independent scrutiny
verdict_headline: Quality regional Punjab developer at a full 34x multiple with decelerating reported growth; pipeline optionality is real but a slow multi-year absorption story, not a 2-3yr or 100x path
verdict_reasoning: Deep-dive pass 1 (2026-09-02): the fundamental quality holds up - ROE ~25%, ROCE ~21%, no promoter pledge, low debt - and the FY26-30 pipeline (~Rs 5,120 Cr GDV on ~12.2 msf land) plus a ~62%-presold ongoing portfolio give real long-horizon optionality.

But the reported trajectory is decelerating (rev +8.5% FY26, ~0% Q1 FY27) while the stock trades at ~34x trailing earnings - a valuation that only works if the pipeline converts on schedule; real-estate accounting lag softens but does not erase this gap.
Cash generation is the weak link: FY26 OCF Rs 27 Cr against Rs 95 Cr PAT, negative FY25 OCF, working-capital days up to ~149, and the build funded by the March-2026 QIP and debt rather than accruals.
Governance caveat: recurring material RPTs with promoter-linked AGI Construction Pvt Ltd for construction on the company's own projects.

Positives that keep conviction at Medium rather than lower: first institutional buying (FII 0 -> 4.68%, 27 holders), Nuvama Buy initiation, and a clean pledge/leverage profile. Thesis-fit cut from 100x-in-10-years to neither - a Rs 3,520 Cr regional developer going 100x is not credible, and reported growth does not support a 2-3yr multibagger case either. Conviction unchanged at Medium (lower edge).

value_chain.note: Post-2018 shakeout left balance-sheet-repaired regional players gaining share; AGI's edge is low-cost Punjab land + local execution. Not a pricing-power story - absorption-led, and demand is concentrated in one state.
